intro.text: A singer king of the distant past and a friend of Jezrien, who tried to resist Odium's influence.

items.text: Sensing the Wind's voice fading, Elodi recognised Odium as a dark god and tried to resist him. He warned Jezrien of coming war between singers and humans and of Odium's growing hold over his people, then left, saying he would go east.

appearance.text: A tall, old singer with black and red carapace whitening at the edges, a long wrinkled face, gemstones in his beard and a broad smile.

personality.text: A kind, peaceable king who listens to the Wind and wants peace between his people and humans.
